hero.desc.0: Reach out to our engineering team for product inquiries, technical consultations, project discussions, or general information. We respond within 24 - 48 hours.
sec.desc.0: International channel support for project coordination, communication, and regional assistance.
sec.desc.1: Quick answers to common questions about our products, services, and project delivery process.
p.0: Reach out to our engineering team for product inquiries, technical consultations, project discussions, or general information. We respond within 24 - 48 hours.
p.1: Our team of engineers is available to discuss your project requirements, answer technical questions, and provide comprehensive proposals for your industrial needs.
p.2: Fill out the form below and our engineering team will get back to you with a detailed response within 24 - 48 hours.
p.3: Visit us at our engineering facility in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. We welcome client visits for facility tours, technical discussions, and equipment inspections.
p.4: We manufacture Falling Film Evaporators, Forced Circulation Evaporators, Rising Film Evaporators, Plate Type Evaporators, and Batch Vacuum Evaporators. All types are available in single, double, triple, and multi-effect configurations with optional TVR (Thermo Vapour Recompressor) / MVR (Mechanical Vapour Recompression) integration.
p.5: Lead times depend on equipment complexity and size. Standard equipment typically takes 8 - 12 weeks from order confirmation. Complete turnkey plants or complex multi-effect systems may require 16 - 24 weeks. We provide a detailed project schedule at the time of order placement.
p.6: Yes, we provide complete installation supervision and commissioning services as part of our turnkey project offering. Our field engineers manage site installation, mechanical alignment, piping connections, electrical hook-up, pre-commissioning checks, startup, performance testing, and operator training.
p.7: Our equipment is designed and fabricated to conform to ASME Section VIII (pressure vessels), TEMA (heat exchangers), IBR (Indian Boiler Regulations), BIS/IS standards, 3-A and EHEDG (hygienic dairy/food equipment), GMP guidelines (pharmaceutical), and PED (EU Pressure Equipment Directive) where required.
p.8: Yes, we provide comprehensive after-sales support including: original spare parts supply, on-site maintenance visits, preventive maintenance programs, performance optimization audits, remote technical support, and operator retraining as needed. We maintain a dedicated after-sales service team.
p.9: Absolutely. We have extensive experience in complete turnkey dairy plant projects - from initial process design, equipment selection, and P&ID development through fabrication, supply, installation, commissioning, performance testing, and operator training. We have delivered plants ranging from 5,000 L/day to 200,000 L/day capacity.
p.10: Join 200+ satisfied clients who trust Gausin for their critical industrial engineering needs.
